description: Upcoming due dates across all courses, with whether each assignment is already submitted (submissionStatus: submitted, graded, draft, not_submitted, not_open_yet, closed, past_due, restricted, unknown). Dates are UTC ISO strings; convert to the user's local time. Use for deadlines, what's due and date ranges, in date order. Pass course with a name or code to filter without looking up an ID. For advice on what to do first, use get_todo instead. Example: "What's due next week?"

course.description: Course name or code to look up, for example "CS 101". Use this instead of courseId when you know the name.

courseId.description: Filter to a specific course ID

daysAhead.description: Number of days ahead to look for due dates

name: get_upcoming_due_dates
title: Get Upcoming Due Dates
